mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes all permission-matrix cell assignments. Injecting a violation adds a cell that should be denied — CustomerRole allowed to ClaimApplication — which LeastPrivilege and FR_002 catch directly.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PermissionMatrixViolation { CustomerRole -> ClaimApplication in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the requirement for claim and decision audit entries. Injecting a violation creates an Approved application with no Submitted→UnderReview audit entry, which AuditCompleteness catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompletenessViolation { some a : LoanApplication | a.appStatus = Approved and (no ae : AuditEntry | ae.auditApp = a and ae.auditPrevStatus = Submitted and ae.auditNewStatus = UnderReview) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the count fact allows duplicate audit entries per transition. Injecting a violation forces two distinct submission entries for one application, which AppendOnly and the exact-count assertion both catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEntry { some disj ae1, ae2 : AuditEntry | ae1.auditApp = ae2.auditApp and no ae1.auditPrevStatus and no ae2.auditPrevStatus and ae1.auditNewStatus = Submitted and ae2.auditNewStatus = Submitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the constraint tying a Decision's decidedBy to the application's assignedOfficer. Injecting a violation creates a Decision whose decidedBy is a different LoanOfficer than the one assigned, which FR_013 catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_WrongOfficerDecides { some d : Decision | some u : User | u.userRole = LoanOfficerRole and u != d.decisionApp.assignedOfficer and d.decidedBy = u }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact removes the one-in-flight constraint. Injecting a violation forces two applications owned by the same customer to both be in-flight simultaneously, which FR_008 catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_TwoInFlightSameCustomer { some disj a1, a2 : LoanApplication | a1.appCustomer = a2.appCustomer and a1.appStatus = Submitted and a2.appStatus = UnderReview }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing this fact allows Decisions to have no reason token. Injecting a violation creates a Decision with no decisionReason, which FR_014 and ValidationBeforeMutation both catch.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DecisionWithoutReason { some d : Decision | no d.decisionReason }
